book.title: Galatia Galatia Ekalesia veize Pauloꞌa Mirihiroteꞌe Soꞌaḡa

content: Iesu mazao Fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano Duduḡa rae Raꞌohe
Galatia ekalesia azaḡa, zaꞌe kauriḡa! Iesu Kerisoꞌa zae veize satauro rana rudaroteꞌe eḡeꞌa doḡoꞌani ihozadu zaeꞌa ubumazeo horoniroteꞌe heuḡa rehano, zamazeꞌe iniuꞌa aro?
E ḡau tiba daꞌo zae mazaonoꞌo ederihi raꞌohe. Zaeꞌa Vine Zaḡoḡa meirotaꞌaꞌe Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotiroteꞌe uꞌano ga emeḡeꞌa haramiroteꞌe hariḡa manoḡa egadu eꞌe mae ḡihiniroteꞌe uꞌano?
Za ufeta kauriḡahe? Zaꞌe Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa ibitozeadu Iesu mazao fieꞌeteꞌe ḡadaheniro, rehano izidi zaꞌe vaze inaraḡa hina hauḡihi raꞌehe?
Ibite zaeꞌa aduga ḡehaḡa hidirotaꞌaꞌe huga oꞌoꞌahe? Aꞌe hube hune huḡeta!
Nagini uꞌano Badiꞌaꞌa za Vine Zaḡoḡa ziniꞌohe zu zae boꞌaḡano haḡai gigiꞌaḡa haḡaeꞌohe? Zaeꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe uꞌano ga zaeꞌa hari manoḡa egadu eꞌe mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe uꞌano?
Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Aberahamoꞌa Badiꞌa mazao fiadu Badiꞌaꞌa aniꞌe duduḡa rae mae ḡihiniro.”
Eꞌanoꞌo fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Aberahamo mariga rae ederoꞌi.

Iuda mene azaḡaꞌe fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa reꞌuma rae raꞌeteꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡano irina ihoziro. Ebu Buka Zaḡoḡanonoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa eꞌe hariḡa manoḡa irina Aberahamo niro, “Haba niduꞌa zamaḡano radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe ḡae mazaonoꞌo manohuga hidiꞌuma.”
Aberahamoꞌe firoteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahine, ani teite fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zuni manohuga hideꞌohe.

Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa reꞌuma rae raꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa aduga tuḡutuḡu hidiꞌuma. Mazaḡa Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Iniu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa bukaḡa zamaḡano mirihiroteꞌe goroḡa niduꞌa iḡaiḡa mene hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌa radiu tuḡutuḡu adugaḡa hidiꞌuma.”
Hube hune iniuꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegotadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae raꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa. Mazaḡa Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa azaḡaꞌe zeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, radiꞌuma.”
Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe fieꞌeteꞌeanoꞌo mene fureraro. Buka Zaḡoḡanoꞌe ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Mose goro ḡoeꞌa niduꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa ꞌouge haḡadu ḡabode radiꞌuma.”

Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe emeḡe rana radiu tuḡutuḡu adugaḡa tiꞌohe. Rehano emeḡe rana tiroteꞌe radiu tuḡutuḡu adugaḡa aꞌe Kerisoꞌa ane rana teadu radiu tuḡutuḡu adugaḡanonoꞌo eme bohafe bufiro. Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, “Ire rana midau tiroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe radiu tuḡutuḡu adugaḡa hidiroteꞌe azaḡa.”

Kerisoꞌa ꞌouge haḡairotaꞌaꞌe, Badiꞌaꞌa Aberahamo haroteꞌe manohugaḡa Keriso Iesu uꞌano Iuda mene azaḡa zuni zinifine, ebu emeꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌaꞌa rifiꞌuma rae ḡoitoriroteꞌe Vineḡa Zaḡoḡa emeḡeꞌa meifine raꞌohe.
Mose Goro Ḡoeꞌa zu Ḡoitore Ḡoeꞌa
Nego nabudi, emeḡe radone zamaḡano hari idaidaḡa ꞌahoga ziꞌuma. Vaze aheuꞌa ḡoere idanadu ḡoitorine, vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa hena mene fahiꞌuma ga ḡoere ꞌahoga mene bare ragate tiꞌuma.

Badiꞌaꞌa Aberahamo zu ane mariga ꞌahoga teite ḡoitoriro. Buka Zaḡoḡano, “Vaze ḡehaḡa,” rae ihozifine, “Marigo duḡuru teite ḡoitoriro,” rae mene reiro, rehano “Vaze tiba daꞌo,” rae ihozifine, “Marigo ꞌahoga teite ḡoitoriro,” rae reiro. Aꞌe Keriso.

Eḡeꞌa reihi raꞌeteꞌe hugaꞌe ꞌahi eꞌe: Badiꞌaꞌa ibite Aberahamo teite ḡoitoriro. Ebu muri 430 enogano Moseonoꞌo goro ḡoeꞌa rifiro. Eꞌanoꞌo Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa Badiꞌa ḡoitore ḡoeꞌa fahadu huga oꞌoꞌa rae rougaꞌe mene idaḡa.

Emeꞌa Mose goro ḡoeꞌa hegoteꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌa emeḡe Mamaꞌa rifiꞌeteꞌe toheḡa meine, aꞌe mene Badiꞌaꞌa Aberahamo teite ḡoitoriroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa uꞌano maꞌeteꞌe toheḡa. Badiꞌaꞌa Aberahamo teite ḡoitoriroteꞌe uꞌano, Moga Badiꞌaꞌa hauꞌeteꞌe toheḡa Aberahamo haro.

Tena Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe nagini veize? Aꞌe vazeꞌa haḡai sauꞌa haḡaine, zeꞌe veꞌoḡa haḡaeha rae ihozifine ragate mirihiroteꞌe goroḡa. Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa ꞌouge gauinu, onamo Aberahamo mariga ꞌahoga, Badiꞌaꞌa ḡoitoriroteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa ariro. Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ane tuḡure vigaonoꞌo nema vazeḡa Mose hanadu haḡairo.
Vaze nuꞌa ḡoitoreꞌetene, nema vazeḡa urateꞌohe. U Badiꞌaꞌa Aberahamo teite ḡoitorirotene, Badiꞌa tibuhuga daꞌo haḡairo.
Mose Goro Ḡoeꞌaꞌe Nagini Veize?
ꞌOugadu Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ḡoitoriroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa hezaohauꞌehe? Mene hune! Badiꞌaꞌa ḡabone rifiꞌeteꞌe goroḡa ḡoeꞌa rififone, emeꞌe goro ḡoeꞌa eꞌe hegotadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae reifo.

Rehano Buka Zaḡoḡaniꞌa ḡau niduꞌaꞌe haḡai sauꞌa inaraḡa hegoteꞌeteꞌe ḡuꞌa azaḡa teige radiuꞌohe rae raꞌohe. Aꞌe, Iesu Keriso mazao fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Badiꞌaꞌa ḡoitoriroteꞌe ḡauḡaꞌe fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zinifine ꞌouge reiro.
Keriso mazao fieꞌeteꞌe madaḡa ꞌizema arogano, Mose goro ḡoeꞌaniꞌa emeꞌe ane hegoteꞌeteꞌe tuḡure azaḡa teige ani ꞌuꞌuḡano obofe tiro, onao emeꞌa Keriso mazao fiteꞌe madaḡa Badiꞌaꞌa furenofiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe emeḡe ibitofiꞌeteꞌe ihoreḡa vazeḡano reiro, onao Kerisoꞌa ariro. Aꞌe, emeꞌa fiadu Badiꞌa ubumao duduḡa rae rouga veize reiro.
Izidi eme Keriso mazao fieꞌeteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa ariro ꞌahine, Mose goro ḡoeꞌaꞌe mene bare emeḡe ibitofiꞌeteꞌe ihoreḡa vazeḡa raꞌohe.
Zae niduꞌa fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, Keriso Iesu teite tiburanadu Badiꞌa ubugaubuga reiro.
Zae niduꞌaꞌe babatiso madu Keriso teite tiburaro ebu dabua iziga haḡairoteꞌe teige, zaꞌe Keriso heuḡa reiro.
Zaꞌe mene vaze nunu. Iuda vazeḡa ga mene Iuda vazeḡa, tuḡure vazeḡa ga mene tuḡure vazeḡa, ohoze ga roḡaeꞌe oꞌoꞌa. Za Keriso Iesu teite tiburanadu zae niduꞌaꞌe tiba.
Za Keriso mone reine, zaꞌe Aberahamo mariga ebu Badiꞌaꞌa ḡoitoriroteꞌe idunaḡano Moze Badiꞌaꞌa ziniꞌeteꞌe toheḡa hiditeꞌe azaḡa.
